chunks: And it is narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim and al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār that they both said:
We said to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام: Should one make up the salat of the eclipse if he comes to know in the morning, and if he comes to know in the evening?
He said: "If both discs were completely eclipsed, you must make it up; but if only part of them was eclipsed, then its make-up is not upon you."

key_terms.أَ يَقْضِي: whether one must perform the make-up prayer
key_terms.الْقُرْصَانِ: the two celestial discs, meaning the sun and the moon

ai.seo_question: When must the eclipse prayer be made up if someone only learns about the eclipse afterward?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on making up the eclipse prayer after learning about the eclipse only after it has passed. If the eclipse of the sun or moon was total, the missed prayer must be made up; if it was partial, there is no obligation of qada'.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1529 - It is narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim and al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar that they said:
"We asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as): Should one make up the prayer for an eclipse if he becomes aware of it in the morning or evening after it has occurred?

He (as) replied: 'If both discs (the sun and the moon) were completely eclipsed, you must make it up. However, if only a part of either of them was eclipsed, then you are not required to make it up.'"
